dedupe_keys.name: bwdb bangladesh hydrological data portal water level discharge rainfall groundwater

description: The Hydroinformatics and Flood Forecasting Circle of the Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB) runs a hydrology portal for the national observation network. Its menus list manual and automated surface water and groundwater stations, with water level, rainfall, observed discharge, evaporation, sediment, salinity, tidal discharge, surface water quality, mean daily discharge and river cross-section (morphology) data, plus groundwater daily and weekly levels, pump test and lithology data. The portal shows hydrographs, sample data, a hydro map and hydrological reports, and links to the Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre. Coverage is Bangladesh, searchable by district. Access is paid, through an online data request for registered users; the charges follow a data rate chart in taka, for example 500 taka per station-year of 3-hourly water level and 40 taka per discharge record. Caveats: the sample data page rendered no table from the cloud session, and the length of the station records was not checked. Simulation uses: river stage, discharge and groundwater series for flood, embankment and irrigation studies in the Ganges, Brahmaputra and Meghna delta. Related records: Nepal real-time river watch (data-nepal-flood-forecasting-real-time-river-watch) and the Global Runoff Data Centre database (data-grdc-global-runoff-database).
